text: LasHeR, VisEvent and RGBT234 use Python reference evaluation. MATLAB cross-validation is pending.

All table values show the original metrics multiplied by 100. VOT22-RGBD results come from the user-supplied table: EAO 73.5672, Accuracy 82.0755 and Robustness 88.3893. The original analysis report was not independently read during that update. Paper values are 73.6, 82.1 and 88.4, matching at one decimal place. Metric definitions differ across datasets, so these results do not form a cross-dataset ranking. DepthTrack uses the VOT toolkit. The other three benchmarks use Python reference evaluation without MATLAB cross-validation. The person1 annotation timing concern remains for VisEvent. Complete LasHeR and RGBT234 artifacts still await local archiving. Retesting official weights and reproducing independent training are different validation stages.

Training loss and training IoU do not replace test-set results.
